files.rationale: Enhance the styling of the item notes page with more visually appealing Tailwind classes to make it less boring
Improve the styling of the notes list component with better visual hierarchy and spacing
Enhance the styling of the note input field with better visual design and user experience

summary: Enhancing the styling of the Item Notes feature frontend to make it more visually appealing. The changes will improve the visual hierarchy, spacing, and overall user experience of the notes page by adding more sophisticated Tailwind CSS classes to the existing components.
